test_cases.name: Semaphore bounds
test_cases.input_setup: Configure model limit=3 and execute 10 concurrent async tasks
test_cases.expected_result: Peak concurrent execution never exceeds 3; remaining tasks queue cleanly
test_cases.evidence: 10 workers executed; strict peak active concurrency = 3 <= 3

test_cases.name: Independent per model
test_cases.input_setup: Configure model-A limit=2 and model-B limit=5, fire 5 concurrent requests each
test_cases.expected_result: Model A throttles at 2; Model B serves all 5 simultaneously
test_cases.evidence: Independent semaphores verified: model-A peak=2, model-B peak=5

test_cases.name: Release on exception
test_cases.input_setup: Acquire semaphore, trigger exception, ensure release in finally block
test_cases.expected_result: Slot freed immediately; subsequent caller acquires without timeout
test_cases.evidence: Semaphore successfully re-acquired by subsequent caller in 0.48ms

test_cases.name: Config-driven concurrency limit
test_cases.expected_result: ModelLimiter parses dynamic limit=7 from config
test_cases.evidence: Limiter successfully read LLM_LIMIT__GPT_4O_MINI=7 from config

test_cases.name: Deadlock prevention under timeout
test_cases.input_setup: Hold sole semaphore slot and attempt second acquire with short timeout
test_cases.expected_result: Acquire aborts with TimeoutError; subsequent release/acquire restores consistency
test_cases.evidence: Timed out cleanly under resource exhaustion; state remained 100% consistent
